# Checkout Rebuild — Design

## Problem
The checkout must be rebuilt across domain, API, UI, observability, and migration work.

## Approach
Deliver the rebuild in cohesive dependency-aware parts.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Domain rules are explicit.
- [ ] API contracts are versioned.
- [ ] UI supports recovery.
- [ ] Migration preserves active carts.
- [ ] Observability covers failure paths.

## Out of scope
- Payment provider replacement.
